title: krn lane run sends the measured brain packet to its session
body:
Outcome: krn lane run starts its claude session with the brain packet that krn lane brief --task ID prints, and the biome-clean record tells a worker to run npm run fast before every commit.
Why: FR-40 measured the packet for lane briefs, but taskBrief in src/cli/lane-run.ts sent the bare task record. Arm B lost 3 of 19 biome-clean units because sessions ran only their own tests and skipped npm run fast.
Proof: a test in test/cli/lane-run.test.ts compares the session prompt with laneBriefText; npm run fast passes.
Scope: src/cli/lane-run.ts, evals/fr40/records.json, test/cli/lane-run.test.ts.
Evidence: evals/fr40/results-lanes.md, docs/adr/0002-brain-v2.md
